name: Titanium.Network.Cookie
summary: Cookie object used to manage the system cookie store and HTTP client cookie store.

properties.name: comment
properties.summary: The comment describing the purpose of this cookie

properties.name: domain
properties.summary: The domain attribute of the cookie.

properties.name: expiryDate
properties.summary: The expiration Date of the cookie.
properties.description:
Date format is "_yyyy_-_MM_-_dd_**T**_HH_**:**_mm_**:**_ss_**.**_SSS_**+0000**"

This has been deprecated and removed since 5.0.0 in Android. Please use the property `maxAge`
for Cookies in Android.

properties.name: httponly
properties.summary: The httponly attribute of the cookie.
properties.description:
On iOS this property cannot be set. On Android, when this property is set to `true`, the cookie will
be used only when transmitting HTTP (or HTTPS) requests.

properties.name: maxAge
properties.summary: Sets the Max-Age attribute of a Cookie, in delta-seconds.

properties.name: originalUrl
properties.summary: The original URL attribute of the cookie.

properties.name: path
properties.summary: The path attribute of the cookie.
properties.description:
In the system cookie store, the default value of the path is "/". In the HTTP client cookie store,
the default value of the path is `null`.

properties.name: secure
properties.summary: The secure attribute of the cookie.
properties.description: Indicates whether this cookie requires a secure connection.

properties.name: version
properties.summary: The version of the cookie specification to which this cookie conforms.

methods.name: isValid
methods.summary: Returns true if the cookie is valid.
methods.description:
This method checks if the cookie is valid. For a cookie to be valid the minimum
properties required are `name`, `value`, `path` and either `domain` or `originalUrl` (iOS only)
